ce_bugs.text: Unsanitized external HTML rendered raw: imported posts cooked with raw_html bypass sanitization and embed view outputs <%= raw post.cooked %>, allowing stored XSS from third-party RSS feed content via PollFeed
e.data.height is never validated as a number, allowing arbitrary string assignment to iframe.height
embed.js has no null/undefined guards for #discourse-comments, discourseUrl, or discourseEmbedUrl, causing silent embed failure with uncaught errors
topic_retriever.rb uses non-atomic SETNX/EXPIRE; if process dies between them the key persists forever with no TTL, permanently throttling that embed URL — should use SET NX EX
Race on concurrent import of same URL: two jobs can both see embed.blank? and create duplicate topic/post; unique index conflict on TopicEmbed.create! aborts transaction with no rescue/retry
Topic title is never updated on re-import; changed RSS article titles leave stale titles forever
PollFeed invalid URL fallback substitutes i.id which may be blank or a non-URL tag id (UUID/URN), causing import to silently return nil and items to be dropped without logging
Embed controller referer check is trivially forgeable via Referer header and only compares host; also silently 403s all embeds if site is renamed
loading.html.erb reloads unconditionally every 30s with no terminal state, looping 'Loading Discussion…' forever when retrieval permanently fails
60-second per-URL throttle allows unbounded job enqueues and outbound fetches for arbitrary distinct URLs, enabling work-queue fill and outbound-request amplification
Non-atomic SETNX followed by EXPIRE in retrieved_recently? can leave a key with no TTL, permanently wedging retrieval for a URL if the process dies between calls
embed.js origin check uses indexOf prefix/substring match instead of exact origin equality, weakening security
disqus.thor removes the --category/-c option without deprecation, breaking existing scripts/CI invoking -c
Raw unrendered post HTML in best.html.erb is an XSS vector since posts bypass the markdown/sanitization pipeline
No timeout on open-uri HTTP fetches in topic_embed.rb:55 and poll_feed.rb:32, allowing Sidekiq workers to hang indefinitely
PollFeed crashes with NoMethodError on feed items lacking 'content' (i.content.scrub), and with retry: false silently aborts processing for that hour
Loading page reloads every 30s forever and never surfaces failure when embed import fails
retrieve_topic job has no failure feedback path; TopicRetriever bails silently leaving the embed page stuck on loading, and non-staff failed imports block retry for 60s per URL
Redis throttle setnx/expire is non-atomic; process death between them leaks a key that permanently blocks retrieval for non-staff — should use SET with EX
discourse_expires_in 1.minute caching headers apply to the loading render, potentially causing CDN/browser caching of the loading page
TopicEmbed.absolutize_urls edge cases untested: non-standard ports, protocol-relative URLs, and javascript: hrefs passing through unsanitized
PollFeed assumes every feed item has :content; raises NoMethodError for items with only description/summary, and retry: false kills the whole run
XSS/origin weakness in embed.js: indexOf substring match allows origins containing discourseUrl as substring; arbitrary height applied
embed.js assumes #discourse-comments element exists with no null check, throwing on misconfigured pages
create_table :top_topics changed with force: true, silently dropping and recreating table and destroying all aggregated topic statistics with no backup
top_topics migration has no rollback/down handling for the destructive table recreation

TopicEmbed#import mutates caller's string via contents << and computes SHA1 after appending 'imported from' footer, so content_sha1 never matches source content and locale string changes trigger spurious rewrites
TopicEmbed#import embeds arbitrary raw HTML from the feed, bypassing sanitization and creating stored-XSS risk if feed is untrusted
Stored XSS: raw_html cook method bypasses sanitization pipeline and rendered with raw post.cooked, allowing onerror/onmouseover attributes on allowed tags like img and a
PollFeed feeds CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content) directly into TopicEmbed.import with no readability pass, storing script/onclick verbatim and enabling persistent XSS
Referer check is weak since referer is client-controlled
Embed iframe posts resize message to request.referer which may be null/stripped, so resizing silently fails; should post to a consistent origin matching the receiver's check
Race condition in TopicEmbed.import: check-then-insert with no rescue of ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique causes concurrent imports to fail jobs and leave embed broken
If PostCreator succeeds but TopicEmbed.create! raises NotUnique, whole topic creation rolls back silently, wasting work repeatedly
content_sha1 update via update_column runs even if revisor.revise! returned false, causing sha drift
poll_feed i.link/i.id fallback can yield non-http url which import silently drops with no logging, causing partial silent import failures
open(url) has no open_timeout/read_timeout or size limit, allowing hostile/slow URLs to block sidekiq workers indefinitely or download gigabytes into memory
absolutize_urls misses protocol-relative //evil.com URLs and relative paths without leading slash
URI(url) on attacker-supplied embed_url can raise uncaught URI::InvalidURIError inside import, killing the job
X-Frame-Options: ALLOWALL is non-standard and may be treated as DENY in some browsers, breaking embedding despite controller granting access
Disqus thor regression: --category option removed so posts lose their category
Disqus import switched to TopicEmbed.import_remote which re-fetches remote content at import time, failing on dead/redirected links or importing unrelated current page content

mrv_findings.text: Gemfile.lock not updated with new gems (ruby-readability, simple-rss), breaking bundle install --frozen/--deployment
poll_feed.rb:33 assumes i.content exists on every feed item; RSS items often only have description or neither, causing NoMethodError and killing the hourly poll
poll_feed.rb:32-35 assumes Atom semantics for i.id fallback; RSS items without id can produce nil url, raising on the regex check or in TopicEmbed.import
String#scrub requires Ruby >= 2.1 but the codebase targets Ruby 2.0.x, so i.content.scrub raises NoMethodError
topic_embed.rb uses require_dependency 'nokogiri' instead of require for a third-party gem, risking LoadError/NameError outside Rails dependency-tracking context
Digest::SHA1 used in topic_embed.rb without requiring 'digest/sha1', relying on incidental load order
best.html.erb:4 assumes @topic_view and @topic_view.topic are non-nil on all render paths; empty posts list crashes the embed page
poll_feed.rb:33 — `i.content` may be nil for Atom entries with only summary, causing NoMethodError; with retry: false the entire hourly poll silently aborts
poll_feed.rb:26 — `feed_key` (Last-Modified/ETag) is dead code; no conditional GET, so all feeds are re-downloaded and re-imported hourly via PostRevisor
topic_embed.rb:38-42 — `content_sha1` is updated unconditionally even when `PostRevisor#revise!` returns false, permanently skipping the changed article
topic_embed.rb:24-35 — concurrent imports race on the unique embed_url index causing unhandled RecordNotUnique; throttle bypassed by staff
loading.html.erb:8-10 — infinite 30s reload with no failure path when retrieval fails (invalid URL, open() error, blank embed_by_username)
embed.js:5-11 — no check that `#discourse-comments` div exists before calling appendChild, causing TypeError on publisher pages missing the div; postMessage resize handshake also unverified
Missing test verification for update path: content_sha1 update, no-op re-import not creating revision, and sha-vs-absolutize ordering invariant are untested
topic_embed.rb:31 — title never validated before import; blank/nil titles can create topics with skip_validations: true (ruby-readability returns nil title)
Disqus import rewrite removes the --category option and category_id lookup, breaking the documented import workflow and losing category assignment (lib/tasks/disqus.thor:114-150)
Disqus import now routes through TopicEmbed.import_remote fetching full remote HTML, which fails at import time for dead Disqus t[:link] URLs (lib/tasks/disqus.thor:114-150)

create_table :top_topics adds force: true to an already-shipped migration, which destroys existing top_topics data on re-run and won't apply to deployed databases (db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb:4)
Unrelated whitespace churn (trailing-space removal, newline at EOF) in an existing migration creates diff noise and merge-conflict risk (db/migrate/20131210181901_migrate_word_counts.rb:4,33)
feed_key is computed but never used, so the 'only import modified feeds' requirement is not enforced and every hourly run re-parses and re-imports all items (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:25-27)
PollFeed re-issues open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url) and full parses hourly with no conditional-GET, and the promised feed-modified cache key does not exist (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:25-27)
Untraceable formatting change (removed blank line after should_revise? guard) bundled with the skip_validations feature (lib/post_revisor.rb:11-14)

cook_method: :raw_html bypasses the entire cooking/sanitization pipeline and PostCreator accepts it from any caller with no restriction, introducing an unsanitized-HTML path into the core post pipeline (lib/post_creator.rb:216, app/models/post.rb:131-135)
RSS i.content is inserted with CGI.unescapeHTML and cooked via return raw, gated only by a loose /^https?\:\/\// URL check, allowing untrusted remote HTML into posts (app/models/post.rb:131-135)
Migration default cook_method: 1 maps to :raw_html enum instead of 0, making all posts bypass markdown/sanitization and render raw HTML
External RSS/HTML content is imported into post raw with no sanitization step anywhere in the embed import path
Redis setnx followed by expire is not atomic; crash between calls leaves key with no TTL, permanently blocking that URL's retrieval
sidekiq retry: false on RetrieveTopic failure paths makes lost retrievals silently unrecoverable, causing endless 'loading' reloads
PollFeed uses i.content without nil check; items without content (Atom summary-only) raise NoMethodError, aborting the entire poll run
CGI.unescapeHTML double-decodes already-escaped HTML bodies, corrupting content
Single embeddable_host scalar setting bakes a one-site assumption into the data model instead of a hosts table/feed registry
PollFeed hardwired to exactly one feed URL and one author username rather than a feed registry
topic_embed.content_sha1 is updated via update_column even when revise! fails, letting hash and content drift so updates are permanently lost
Loading sentinel embed page has no error/terminal state; failures cause infinite 30-second reloads hammering embed/best and re-enqueuing jobs
open(url) in TopicRetriever has no timeout, so a hang blocks indefinitely
Check-then-insert on embed_url creates a race between controller job and hourly poll producing duplicate topics/lost updates; should be upsert with optimistic guard
embed.js uses indexOf substring comparison for origin validation, allowing lookalike origins to hijack the iframe messaging channel
feed_key cache key is built but never read; no conditional GET/ETag or item LIMIT, causing hourly full re-parse and unbounded first-run backlog imports
import_remote fetches arbitrary URL with no timeout, size cap, content-type check, or SSRF containment, enabling slow-loris-style worker exhaustion
Controller spec mocks TopicEmbed/TopicView entirely, verifying wiring only and not actual rendering for anonymous users
Migration add_cook_method_to_posts defaults cook_method to 1 (raw_html) instead of 0 (regular), causing all posts to skip the cooking/markdown pipeline and bypass XSS-relevant sanitization
Existing migration create_top_topics edited in place to add force: true, so re-runs will drop and recreate the table, destroying data
disqus:import task removed the --category option and switched to TopicEmbed.import_remote fetching remote content over HTTP, breaking existing scripts and changing import behavior silently
post_revisor.rb save changed to save(validate: !@opts[:skip_validations]), allowing imported embedded posts to bypass all post validations on revision
Whitespace-only edit to existing migration migrate_word_counts.rb, including stripped trailing newline, polluting the diff

Stored XSS: post.cook with cook_method raw_html returns unsanitized raw feed HTML, and embed view renders it via raw post.cooked; Readability whitelist doesn't strip event handlers like onerror/onload, allowing stored XSS from imported third-party articles/feeds

HTML/attribute injection: topic_embed.rb interpolates url into HTML with only a weak ^https?:// regex check, allowing crafted URLs (e.g. with ' onmouseover=') to inject raw HTML into post body, leading to stored XSS

Reflected XSS: embed.html.erb interpolates client-controlled Referer header into inline JS postMessage call without escaping; ensure_embeddable only validates the host, so attacker-controlled path/query can break out of the JS string
SSRF: open-uri fetches in TopicEmbed and PollFeed follow redirects without host/scheme validation, allowing the embeddable host to redirect the server to internal addresses like 169.254.169.254
Weak origin check in embed.js uses substring matching (indexOf) instead of strict origin equality, potentially allowing suffix/subdomain origin matches when trusting e.data.height
topic_retriever_spec.rb:32-43 stubs retrieved_recently? and only tests dispatch, leaving real throttle logic (setnx/expire, no_throttle staff bypass) untested
No test coverage for the no_throttle: user.try(:staff?) path wired in retrieve_topic.rb:16
poll_feed_spec.rb:31-39 stubs poll_feed itself; real poll_feed body (SimpleRSS parsing, url fallback branch, CGI.unescapeHTML, user lookup, TopicEmbed.import) never executed by tests
post_revisor.rb:85 save(validate: !@opts[:skip_validations]) behavioral change has no test passing skip_validations to revise!
embed_controller_spec.rb:36-42 asserts against mocks instead of verifying Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...) with correct embed_url/user_id
topic_embed_spec.rb:39-42 never verifies content_sha1 is updated, so regression to a no-op update_column causing permanent re-revision would go undetected
cook_method migration default of 1 means raw_html, backfilling all existing posts to raw_html so cooked output silently becomes raw markdown
PostCreator never sets cook_method for new posts, so all new posts inherit DB default 1 (raw_html) and are rendered raw
force: true added to create_table :top_topics migration will DROP TABLE and irreversibly destroy existing top_topics data on re-execution
topic_embeds migration creates no foreign keys, allowing dangling topic_id/post_id references that break the embed route when topics/posts are deleted
